description.narrative: MCC's Board voted to terminate this program in August 2025. The Mauritania Threshold Program, signed in 2025, seeks to assist the Government of the Islamic Republic of Mauritania in addressing two constraints to economic growth: expensive, unreliable, and unequal electricity services, and vulnerability to environmental hazards.

condition.narrative: The Mauritania Threshold may be suspended or terminated, among other conditions, if the Mauritania Threshold (i) fails to comply with its commitments under the agreements entered into with MCC in relation to the program, (ii) engages in a pattern of actions inconsistent with the criteria used by MCC to determine eligibility for the program, or (iii) engages in activities contrary to the national security interests of the United States. Disbursements of funding under a Threshold Program are subject to specific conditions set forth in the Threshold Program agreement for the individual projects funded thereby, as well as general conditions, such as the delivery of implementation, fiscal accountability, and monitoring and evaluation plans.
